title: Enter’s model-list proxy gets the right response
summary:
The model list got a working proxy and a smaller catalog; software occasionally benefits from knowing what it actually serves.

Enter’s `/api/generate/openai/models` proxy now requests the upstream model-list path instead of its root, returning a model list rather than a redirect. The same PR adjusted site caching and fixed a TypeScript compilation error.

Removed `mistral-naughty` from the available model list and shared registry, along with its romance and Roblox aliases.

Removed unused services and orphaned model IDs, leaving the registry aligned with 18 available services. Several model descriptions and OpenAI o4 Mini’s capitalization were also tidied up.
